name: functional-acceptance
title_zh: 从用户视角验收功能，而不是替代码找通过理由
tagline_zh: 写完了、测过了、CI 绿了，可用户点进去还是卡在第三步——它专门盯这个落差：把功能当成用户第一次走完的那条路来验。
tagline_en: Green CI and passing unit tests don't mean the user can finish the flow. This verifies the real outcome by.
desc_en: Verify a feature's real user outcome, recheck a saved user-flow regression, or plan its acceptance. Use when asked to confirm that a feature or fix actually works for users; keep code review, unit-test explanation, and implementation-only requests in their original scope.
why_zh: 它先问「用户要拿到什么结果」，再倒推该看哪一步，而不是顺着实现顺序找证据。代码审查、单测讲解。
why_en: It starts from the user-visible outcome and works backward to the step that proves it, instead of collecting evidence along the.
limit_zh: 它只做验收判断，不写实现、不改代码、不替你补测试。需要能实际跑起来的环境或可复现的用户路径；只有静态代码。
limit_en: Judgment only: no implementation, no code changes, no test writing. Needs a runnable environment or reproducible user path; static code alone yields.
title_en: Acceptance testing from the user's seat, not the code's
